mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, delete_status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND delete_status = '1' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, delete_status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_status = '1'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, delete_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{deleteStatus}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND delete_status = '1'
UPDATE sys_user SET delete_status = '2', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_status = '1'
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, delete_status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE delete_status = '1' ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.delete_status, u.create_time, u.update_time FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.delete_status = '1' INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.delete_status = '1' AND p.permission_code = 'villageHomestay:add' ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.delete_status, u.create_time, u.update_time FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.delete_status = '1' INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.delete_status = '1' AND p.permission_code = #{permissionCode} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
